# CIB - The Culinary Institute of Bangladesh
> Bangladesh's premier NSDA-accredited professional culinary training institute, located in Dhanmondi, Dhaka.

## About CIB

- Full Name: The Culinary Institute of Bangladesh (CIB)
- Short Name: CIB
- Type: NSDA-Accredited Professional Culinary Training Institute
- Founded: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Focus: Practical, hands-on professional culinary education
- Language of Instruction: Bengali and English
- Campus: Dhanmondi, Dhaka-1205, Bangladesh
- Accreditations: NSDA (National Skills Development Authority), ISO-HACCP certified

## Flagship Course: Professional Chef Course (Basic to Advance)

> This is CIB's primary and most comprehensive culinary training program. It is 100% practical.

### Core Details

- Course Name: Professional Chef Course (Basic to Advance)
- Duration: 3 months
- Schedule: 3 days per week
- Mode: 100% Practical (hands-on kitchen training, zero theory-only sessions)
- Language: Bengali (instruction), English (materials)
- Batch Size: Limited seats per batch
- Location: CIB Campus, Dhanmondi, Dhaka

### Fee Structure

- Total Course Fee: 44,000 BDT
- Installment Plan:
  - 1st Installment (Admission): 16,000 BDT
  - 2nd Installment (Month 2): 14,000 BDT
  - 3rd Installment (Month 3): 14,000 BDT
- No hidden charges

### Curriculum Highlights

- Total Recipes: 120+ authentic recipes
- Cuisines Covered: 16+ international and local cuisines
- Included Cuisines: Bangladeshi, Indian, Chinese, Thai, Italian, Continental, Arabic, Mexican, Japanese, Korean, and more
- Free Bonus Module: Pastry & Bakery (included at no extra cost)
- Practical Skills: Knife skills, mise en place, sauce mastery, plating, food safety (HACCP), kitchen management
- Industry Exposure: Live kitchen sessions with professional chef instructors

### Certifications Awarded (Upon Completion)

1. NSDA Certificate - National Skills Development Authority (Government accredited)
2. ISO-HACCP Certificate - International food safety and hygiene certification
3. CIB Institutional Certificate - Issued by The Culinary Institute of Bangladesh

### Free Gifts Upon Enrollment

- 1 Professional Chef Uniform (full set)
- 1 Professional Knife Set
- 1 Cutting Board
- 1 Culinary Reference Sheet (recipe & technique handbook)

### Who Is This Course For?

- Aspiring professional chefs
- Home cooks seeking professional credentials
- Hospitality and hotel management students
- Restaurant entrepreneurs and F&B business owners
- Anyone seeking NSDA-recognized culinary certification in Bangladesh

## Other Courses Offered by CIB

> Note: The Professional Chef Course (Basic to Advance) is the flagship program. Other short and specialized courses are also available.

- Pastry & Bakery Course
- Barista & Coffee Course
- Short culinary workshops

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI)

Q: What is CIB?
A: CIB (The Culinary Institute of Bangladesh) is a professional culinary training institute in Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh. It is accredited by NSDA (National Skills Development Authority) and offers hands-on chef training.

Q: How long is the Professional Chef Course at CIB?
A: The Professional Chef Course (Basic to Advance) is 3 months long, with classes 3 days per week, and is 100% practical.

Q: How much does the CIB chef course cost?
A: The total fee is 44,000 BDT, payable in 3 installments: 16,000 BDT at admission, then 14,000 BDT and 14,000 BDT in subsequent months.

Q: What certifications do students receive at CIB?
A: Students receive 3 certificates: (1) NSDA Certificate - government-recognized, (2) ISO-HACCP Certificate - international food safety, and (3) CIB Institutional Certificate.

Q: Where is CIB located?
A: CIB is located at House-160, 1st Floor (Beside Longlife Hospital), Lake Circus, Kalabagan, Dhanmondi, Dhaka-1205, Bangladesh.

Q: How many recipes are taught in the CIB chef course?
A: 120+ authentic recipes from 16+ international cuisines are taught, plus a free Pastry & Bakery module.

Q: Does CIB provide any free gifts with enrollment?
A: Yes. Students receive a free chef uniform, professional knife set, cutting board, and culinary reference sheet upon enrollment.

Q: How can I contact CIB or enroll?
A: Call or WhatsApp +8801338958997, email contact@cibdhk.com, or visit the campus in Dhanmondi, Dhaka. Online registration is available at https://cibdhk.com/admission/.
